title: External Temporal Constraints - Resource-Refinery Framework
description: Temporal deadlines that originate from external regulatory bodies (grant agencies, study protocols, IRB requirements) identified through INTENT-OS resource mining. OSF submission workflow serves as parsing/formalization node. Deadlines are resource-specific and vary by pursued grant/study.

workflow.description: GitHub Actions workflow implementing this constraint

authority_layer.description: Regulatory authority chain: external → parsing → workflow

regulatory_body.example: INTENT-OS Resource Specification (NSF, NIH, grant agency, or study protocol)

parsing_node.description: System layer that translates external deadline to workflow

resource_source.description: Framework component identifying resources with deadlines

deadline_source.description: Origin and scope of the deadline requirement

scope.description: General framework (different resources have different deadlines) or specific resource

deadline_variability.example: Deadline determined by specific grant/study requirements identified through INTENT-OS resource-miner

osf_role.description: OSF's function in this constraint framework

purpose.example: Translates INTENT-OS resource specification into pre-registration submission workflow

authority.example: Submission gateway (not regulatory authority itself; channels external requirements)

for_regulatory_body.example: Ineligible for grant funding, study protocol invalid, or publication restrictions per grant/study requirements

for_workflow.example: Pre-registration cannot be submitted/published through OSF for that resource

z2_ratified.description: Z2 (Operator Ratification) approval of this constraint

resource_refinery_branch.description: Flag: This constraint is a branch point for future resource-refinery automation (deadline extraction, constraint generation)

future_automation.description: Potential automation branches for resource-refinery layer
example: Automatic deadline extraction from INTENT-OS resource metadata
Constraint generation per resource (filing external_constraint per grant/study)
Deadline enforcement at OSF submission time based on pursued resource
